hotels.vendor_name: New World Millennium Hong Kong Hotel
hotels.title: Hong Kong Harbourfront Luxury with Club Lounge Access, Daily Breakfast & Two-Hour Free-Flow Cocktails
hotels.description: Poised on Victoria Harbour in the lively Tsim Sha Tsui East district, New World Millennium Hong Kong Hotel is a polished five-star address with direct access to some of the city's best shopping, dining and entertainment. A standout feature is the Residence Club - a smart, light-filled lounge on the 15th floor with sweeping views of Victoria Harbour. The hideaway's seven dining outlets span everything from Cantonese classics at Tao Li and Japanese favourites at Sagano, to French fare at La Table French Brasserie and international delights of Cafe East. An impressive wine cellar and The Lounge round out a dining array that makes staying in feel out of this world. With two MTR stations less than a 10-minute walk away, wider Hong Kong is at your fingertips. Eat your way through the Temple Street Night Market, wander down to Victoria Harbour, visit The Peak for breathtaking views of Hong Kong or venture further afield for Causeway Bay.
